ex.s: This project will select 10 visual artists and 10 writers to create artwork that will be displayed on temporary signs along the multi-use path.
ex.t: 该项目将选出10名视觉艺术家和10名作家，创作将在多功能步道沿线的临时标牌上展出的作品。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
ex.t: 营员们将彼此分享他们多彩的想法和想象力，并合作通过可视化、素描和非传统技法进行创作，画出最酷的壁画，这幅壁画将在公共场合展出供所有人观看。

ex.s: As this artwork is rarely on display, people have sometimes queued up to six hours for a chance to see it.
ex.t: 由于这件艺术品很少展出，人们有时会排队长达六小时只为有机会一睹其风采。

ex.s: This can be a useful way of displaying the kind of life the person led and even, Sometimes, what he/she was really like.
ex.t: 这可以是展示一个人所过的生活方式的有用方式，有时甚至可以展示他/她真正是什么样的人。

defs.def: to show signs of sth, especially a quality or feeling 显示，显露，表现（尤指特性或情感）

ex.s: All kinds of human emotions are on display: sad (tearful goodbyes), happy (family get-togethers), anxious (waiting in a long line) and upset (missing a flight).
ex.t: 各种各样的人类情感都在展现：悲伤（含泪的告别）、快乐（家庭团聚）、焦虑（排长队等候）和沮丧（误了航班）。

defs.def: to show information 计算机等
to show a special pattern of behaviour that is intended to attract a female bird or animal 雄性的鸟兽
an arrangement of things in a public place to inform or entertain people or advertise sth for sale 陈列；展览
an act of performing a skill or of showing sth happening, in order to entertain 展示；表演
an occasion when you show a particular quality, feeling or ability by the way that you behave （特性、情感或能力的）显示，表现，表露

ex.s: Most obviously, the men displayed lower blood sugar levels at the start of their workouts when they had skipped breakfast than when they had eaten.
ex.t: 最明显的是，这些男性在不吃早餐时开始锻炼的血糖水平比吃早餐时更低。

ex.s: It has a digital display that records your steps, speed and distance, as well as monitoring your heart rate and calories burnt.
ex.t: 它有一个数字显示屏，记录你的步数、速度和距离，同时监测你的心率和消耗的卡路里。

defs.def: the words, pictures, etc. shown on a computer screen （计算机屏幕上的）显示，显像

ex.s: The large board in the corner had been replaced by a big screen, where customers’ comments on the month’s best-seller were being displayed.
ex.t: 角落里的大板子已被一块大屏幕取代，屏幕上显示着顾客对当月畅销书的评论。
